messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Running an R CMD check using ggplot2 and dev_mode()
parts:
Hi Brian,

If you're willing to just have ggplot2 v0.9, do:

require(devtools)

I suspect the problem is that you've installed it in dev mode (which
is handy for having multiple versions of a package around, but can be
a bit tricky). Hopefully someone else will chime in if you need both
.89 and .9

Cheers,

Josh

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Running an R CMD check using ggplot2 and dev_mode()
parts:
> I suspect the problem is that you've installed it in dev mode (which
> is handy for having multiple versions of a package around, but can be
> a bit tricky).  Hopefully someone else will chime in if you need both
> .89 and .9

Yes, this is a bug in devtools - currently your .libPaths() doesn't
affect the libpaths that R CMD check sees because it's run in a
separate process. I know what the fix is, but I need to rewrite the
basic system call process (now that I know system2 exists) and test it
on windows.

Hadley
